collection.title: Ford Focus Hatchback 2008 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Focus Hatchback 2008 - 2011 version requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 17" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Focus which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
